Saikyou Habu Shougi.name: Saikyou Habu Shogi
Saikyou Habu Shougi.summary: Saikyou Habu Shogi is the premiere shogi game on the Nintendo 64, and one of 3 Japanese launch titles alongside Super Mario 64 and Pilotwings 64.

Wildwaters.name: WildWaters
Wildwaters.summary: The water-based arcade racer will offer six different characters to choose from as well as three different kayak types, each with their own respective strengths and weaknesses. Wildwater will send up to two players down six perilous river courses, highlighted by realistic water physics and eye-popping graphics.
